key.name: panel-mode
key.summary: What to draw on the top bar
key.description: words: "Peak" / "Off-peak". time: next rate change on your clock. dot: a filled circle when peak, hollow when off-peak. clock: just your local time. none: nothing (the menu is still reachable by keyboard).

key.name: hour12
key.summary: Use a 12-hour clock in times shown by the menu

key.name: colourise
key.summary: Colour the panel text green when off-peak and amber when peak

key.name: notify-on-change
key.summary: Send a desktop notification when the billing rate changes

key.name: auto-update-holidays
key.summary: Fetch the Chinese public-holiday list once a day
key.description: Falls back silently to the bundled list when offline.

key.name: holiday-feed-url
key.description: Any JSON document of the shape {"chinaPublicHolidays": {"dates": ["YYYY-MM-DD", ...]}} is accepted.

key.name: holiday-overrides
key.summary: Cached holiday dates downloaded from the feed, one YYYY-MM-DD per line

key.name: holiday-overrides-fetched-at
key.summary: ISO timestamp of the last successful holiday-feed fetch
